origin.url: Not published online: specimen filled in by hand by LandingAI staff

origin.title: Request for Mortgage Assistance Form (Chase), page 1, hand-completed specimen
origin.clearance_note: Page 1 of Chase's published Request for Mortgage Assistance form, printed, filled in by hand by a LandingAI staff member with invented data, and scanned. Every name, Social Security number, date of birth, phone number, email address, mailing address, loan number and counselor detail on it is fictitious, written for this specimen; the phone numbers use the 555 range. No real borrower's data is present. Taken from LandingAI's internal marketing document library (doc35); PDF metadata cleared. The Chase name and logo appear because they are printed on the form itself; Chase did not produce or endorse this specimen.

notes: The request supplied the schema (doc_35_chase_mortgage_assistance_handwritten_form_schema.json, used unchanged, 27 leaf fields) and named no feature page or fields. The overlay pairs two handwritten values (the loan number and borrower name) with two hand-ticked checkboxes (primary residence, owner occupied). The borrower name is featured because the data is an invented specimen. Occurrence 1 is pinned for the two property checkboxes: occurrence 0 is the question label. A fifth field was tried twice and dropped: real_estate_tax_details.real_estate_tax_payer and insurance_details.insurance_payer both have correct ranges ('[x] Lender does') but their boxes land one and two rows low in the lower section of the form, so neither crop shows its tick. Boolean fields derived from tick marks ground OFF, to the question rather than the tick.
